assessment_basis: Repository README, architecture, implementation entry points, interface documentation and CI definitions were inspected for the recorded gates. The full target build and test matrix was not re-run during this adoption; this is not a new CI certification.

evidence.claim: Defines the read-only device and driver workbench, supported Windows desktop target and prohibited driver writes.
Documents the user-space inspection, package analysis and reporting boundaries.
Provides repository security and vulnerability-reporting guidance.
Defines the Windows desktop build and distributable packaging workflow.
Builds and tests the supported Windows desktop executable in CI.
Contains the primary application implementation for the bounded device and package workbench.
Contains regression tests for package parsing, inventory and report behavior.
Provides the documented application entry point used by the supported desktop workflow.
Documents the optional versioned Reaper native ABI boundary while keeping device work read-only.
Contains regression coverage for the application and its optional integration boundary.
Builds the Windows target and runs the repository test suite in CI.

next_gate: Exercise the end-to-end read-only inventory, package inspection and reporting path on the supported Windows target.
Add adversarial, fuzz and fault-injection evidence for PE, INF, ZIP and UDRV inputs.
Record executable provenance, compatibility coverage and recovery behavior for the supported release path.
